findings.title: Avoid interpolating shard queries a second time in runSplitQuery
findings.body: Queries interpolated here are subsequently passed to runSplitQuery, which now calls applyTemplateVariables again for every shard batch. Template interpolation is not idempotent when a variable's value contains variable-like text. For example, if a service variable has the literal value `$other`, the first pass correctly produces a selector containing that value, but the second pass expands `$other` if that variable exists, querying a different service. Keep the early interpolation needed for shard selection, but ensure runSplitQuery can accept already-interpolated targets without applying template variables again. The updated test asserting five interpolation calls currently enshrines this double-processing rather than preventing it.
